question: Does FOMC statement text add predictive information beyond publication-aware EUR/USD history?
data_source: Federal Reserve Board official policy statements and non-revised archived H.10 releases
decision_rule: 23:59 America/New_York on the calendar day after the statement publication date
price_availability_rule: 23:59 America/New_York on the actual archived H.10 release date; use only observations in a release available by decision
label: EUR/USD log return from the first observed noon quote after decision through the quote 20 observations later; up iff return > 0
selection: lowest validation log loss; smaller C breaks a tie; best price family chosen on validation only
final_fit: refit selected settings on train plus validation, after purging labels unavailable at confirmation start
primary_contrast: confirmation log loss reduction: selected best price minus fusion
duplicate_policy: retain first exact normalized body only; flag previous-document five-word-shingle Jaccard >=0.9 without discarding economically meaningful edits
secondary_diagnostics: 14-calendar-day price-availability delay stress with frozen settings
claims: historical predictive association under delayed public-reference quotes; no executable P&L, causal effect, equity benchmark score or untouched future holdout
